item.title: I won a championship that doesn't exist
item.description:
📝 The trust model there is the same trust model Google has in that “this site looks authoritative” but with the same Achilles heel - the model cannot tell a real source from one I registered last Tuesday. A reader arriving at the Wikipedia article sees a paragraph with a citation. Wikipedia is quoting my site.
🔗 Read more: https://ron.stoner.com/How_I_Won_a_Championship_That_Doesnt_Exist/

item.title: Warp is now open-source
item.description:
📝 In this spirit, we are coupling a few major product improvements with this launch to make Warp more open and customizable. com/warpdotdev/warp with an AGPL license. The Warp team will help guide what gets built, when and how, but we see Warp fundamentally becoming a collaborative effort with our community.
🔗 Read more: https://www.warp.dev/blog/warp-is-now-open-source
